action_items: No backend code changes required — the MIS/WC parity fix (fetch_wc_overrides + per-center override block in mis_dashboard.py + commission_target/gst_target handling in center_accounts.calculate_working_capital_standing + get_wc_table) works correctly for summary, per-center rows, and working-capital calculation.

Frontend verification (out of scope here): confirm MIS Dashboard UI and Franchise Owner Dashboard UI bind to summary.total_expenses / total_gst / total_commissions / profit and per-center centers[].expenses/gst/commissions/profit exactly as returned — the APIs are correct.
critical_code_review_comments: mis_dashboard.get_mis_overview applies overrides correctly at both summary (L283-297) and per-center level (L357-372) using subtract-source + add-target arithmetic. ov_map keyed on (center, month). Verified: works for single-month custom ranges.

Potential edge case (not hit in tests): If a user sets an override for a month OUTSIDE the selected period but within the derived month-set (fetch_wc_overrides derives months from start→end inclusively), the override still matches. This is correct because the period is month-aligned in the parity tests. For mid-month custom ranges (e.g., 2025-05-10..2025-05-20), the override still applies to the whole-month aggregate — acceptable since WC table is always whole-month.

center_accounts.get_wc_table (L589-592) correctly reads commission_target/gst_target overrides as absolute replacements (not deltas). Matches the subtract-source+add-target logic in MIS dashboard, so both endpoints converge.
calculate_working_capital_standing now applies commission_target/gst_target (verified via the forced-loss test — WC dropped from 900000 base to negative territory).
Minor: fetch_wc_overrides in mis_dashboard.py lines 41-74 silently returns {} on date parse errors — ok for robustness, but should at least log.warning for traceability. Non-blocking.
